LESSON: DIVISION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.7: Division

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Division. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Division means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Division.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Division
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.
